title: Immersive Sensory Projections for Hospitalized Patients
official: Immersive Sensory Projections: Evaluating the Impact of an Immersive Sensory Environment (Visual, Auditory and Olfactory) on Reducing the Overall Discomfort of Patients Hospitalized in the Resuscitation and Continuing Care Units
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the impact of adding three sensory elements (visual, auditory, olfactory) on reducing discomfort in patients hospitalized in the intensive care unit/continuing care unit.

interventions.name: Hospitalization in intensive care or continuing care unit

sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
